name: observed-ego-side-switch-generalization-v1
hypothesis: The observed-margin controller with ego-corroborated late obstacle-side switching increases completion on unseen official-generator geometries without adding paired contacts or damage, reducing paired DNF progress, or causing substantial lap-time regressions against the active bare Agent route.
evidence_scope: Fresh paired local official-generator evaluation. The 23-cell predecessor is consumed development evidence only; this protocol does not reuse its screen or open the previous study's sealed confirmation or blind partitions.

source_snapshots.construction: Read committed agent.py bytes with SHA256 cbfd1a544dd3eef30a193f97b93612ab67126fbc1d3cb41fd0027f08c997dd19. Copy them unchanged for control. For candidate, replace the sole byte sequence '_CompoundClearingBrakeCarryController()' with '_ObservedEgoSideSwitchController()'. Assert exactly one original occurrence and that replacing this sequence in the control snapshot yields the candidate snapshot byte-for-byte. The selected Agent route is the sole source-byte difference; the candidate route includes the already developed observed-margin and ego-side-switch behavior.

predecessor.development_decision: RETAIN_DIAGNOSTIC_CANDIDATE on 23 consumed cells against both baseline and prior margin candidate, with no paired safety veto. It is a screen-selection rationale, not fresh generalization evidence.
predecessor.prior_confirmation_and_blind: SEALED_UNRUN; never open or recycle them for this candidate

seed_derivation: For each partition and zero-based index i, interpret the first four SHA256 bytes of UTF-8 'observed-ego-side-switch-generalization-v1:<partition>:<i>' as an unsigned big-endian 32-bit integer. No map geometry or outcome was inspected when choosing seeds or spot-check cells.
freshness_audit: The 32 generated geometry seeds are pairwise distinct and absent from the 205-value conservative historical seed set extracted from existing experiments JSON. That set includes the 180 DrQ training/evaluation reservations, all 16 prior observed-margin screen/confirmation/blind seeds, seven legacy development seeds with seed42 already in the DrQ set, a recorded geometry seed35, and two conservatively included non-geometry RNG values. Before this protocol was written, none of the 32 exact decimal strings occurred in workspace JSON, JSONL, Markdown, text, CSV, log, or Python files searched with rg -uuu outside environment, Git, and ignored artifact directories. Historical training use beyond recorded artifacts cannot be proved absent. Reserve each geometry seed across every track ID.
evaluation_budget: 8 screen, 16 confirmation, and 8 blind independent geometry seeds, each crossed with track IDs1-4: 32/64/32 canonical paired cells. Two arms require 256 cold-process canonical episodes; 2/4/2 repeat cells across both arms add 16 deterministic-reload episodes, for 272 maximum. A repeat is not an independent geometry sample.
decision_rule: Use tools/evaluate_bare_generalization.py unchanged. On screen and confirmation, reject any lost control finish, paired increase in collisions or damage, paired DNF progress decrease, or shared completed lap more than 5 percent slower. Otherwise retain only a lexicographic improvement: more finishes; at equal finishes, mean progress greater by more than 1e-9; at equal finishes and progress, lower total time on mutually completed laps. Missing cells, operational errors, failed spot-check reproducibility, or source/model/protocol/helper/environment/harness hash mismatch block sealing. Require screen RETAIN and finalist seal before confirmation; require confirmation RETAIN and confirmation-accepted seal before blind. The screen-fixed candidate cannot be altered or reselected after opening confirmation. Blind is evaluated once by the same rule and reported whether it succeeds or fails; no blind-driven tuning or replacement candidate is allowed on this partition.
promotion_gate: Only a blind RETAIN with no paired safety veto supports activating this frozen local candidate. A screen or confirmation failure ends this protocol without opening later partitions. Even a passing blind supports only measured local official-generator improvement, not a guarantee on every possible track or official Linux CPU certification.
road_contact_interpretation: Offtrack and partial-offtrack samples are descriptive diagnostics and do not override the paired decision rule; brief grass contact alone is not an official disqualification.
limits: The four track IDs share the geometry produced by a given seed and primarily vary obstacle placements; the independent geometry counts are 8/16/8, not 32/64/32. A positive result remains finite-sample evidence with correlated cells. The separate official Linux runtime and final ZIP certification remain required before submission.
